sql: SELECT "Apartments"."apt_id" AS k, (CAST("Apartments"."room_count" AS REAL) / "Apartments"."bathroom_count") AS m1 FROM "Apartments" WHERE (CAST("Apartments"."room_count" AS REAL) / "Apartments"."bathroom_count") IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: Apartments.number of rooms relative to number of bathrooms
why: number of rooms / number of bathrooms: a ratio of two quantities in count
rank Apartments rows by number of rooms relative to number of bathrooms

sql: SELECT "Apartments"."apt_id" AS k, ("Apartments"."bathroom_count" - "Apartments"."room_count") AS m1 FROM "Apartments" WHERE ("Apartments"."bathroom_count" - "Apartments"."room_count") IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: Apartments.number of bathrooms minus number of rooms
why: number of bathrooms - number of rooms: both in count and of the same kind (same additivity) on the same one apartment unit
rank Apartments rows by number of bathrooms minus number of rooms
